kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أحتقب (form VIII)
# أَحْتَقِبُ (ʔaḥtaqibu) /ʔaħ.ta.qi.bu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِحْتَقَبَ (iḥtaqaba)
# أُحْتَقَبُ (ʔuḥtaqabu) /ʔuħ.ta.qa.bu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَقَبَ (iḥtaqaba)
# أَحْتَقِبَ (ʔaḥtaqiba) /ʔaħ.ta.qi.ba/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِحْتَقَبَ (iḥtaqaba)
# أُحْتَقَبَ (ʔuḥtaqaba) /ʔuħ.ta.qa
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
